title: twin/<site>/<device>/cmd/<action>
description: Backend to the simulator, for simulated devices only (never GW-01). Actions: degrade, restore, maintenance (machine monitors); jam (conveyor monitors); door_open, door_close (door sensors); route (badges); goto, buzz, fall, still, cancel, sos, checkin, skip_checkin (badges, demo); leak, clear (gas detectors, leak sensors); alarm, reset (fire panel bridge); find_me (asset tags, seconds); silence (any sim device stops publishing, to demonstrate staleness); feed (a press monitor: a raw pallet was dropped at the infeed, units = blanks), repair (machine monitor: a work order fits a new bearing, seconds); fix_leaks, service (compressor monitors).

seconds.description: door_open, still, find_me (demo, up to 10 min) and repair, service (a work order's job time, up to 2 h).

path.description: goto only: walkway waypoints [x, z] to follow on the way to (x, z).

units.description: feed only: blanks on the raw pallet dropped at the press infeed.
